attribution.source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/524245 (page 'surf_intro', submitter Chent; the download surf_intro.rar holds surf_intro.vpk, the CS2 map the page describes: 'a tier 1 hybrid skill surf map. It contains 7 stages, gradually increasing in difficulty'). Licence on the page: the generic GameBanana default, Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 4.0; the page says nothing further about altering or redistributing. Converted from the Source 2 .vpk with ValveResourceFormat (MIT); the author's textures and baked lighting are not carried, the game's own prototype textures are used. The author is credited on screen at the map change. Removal on request: tell the repository owner and the map is withdrawn.

notes: A CS2 (Source 2) map imported through tools/vrf_import.py. Timer volumes are the mapper's own map_start / map_end; the seven stages are not zoned yet (one linear course).
